name: accordion
description: collapsible rows on native <details>/<summary> with a rotating chevron. share a name across items for one-open-at-a-time behavior. zero javascript state.

name: article
description: article reading layout — back link, banner, title, date + tags, then a body slot with staggered fade-ins. pair with prose for the markdown body.

name: article-list
description: searchable, tag-filterable grid of article cards. animated banners stay frozen in grayscale until hover, then play in full color.

name: asset-sidebar
description: scrollable image/asset sidebar. drag a row into a textarea or click insert; optional drop zone for uploads.

name: badge
description: small chip. static label by default; pass onClick to make it a toggle/filter chip, with active swapping to the solid look.

name: breadcrumb
description: breadcrumb trail from caller-supplied items; the last crumb is the muted current page. ships a crumbsFromPath helper.

name: button
description: polymorphic button with five variants, optional icons, hover tooltip, and click-to-clipboard. renders as an anchor when given href.

name: calendar
description: month date grid with selectable days, today ring, and prev/next header. pass renderDay to layer dots or counts onto cells.

name: calendar-nav
description: period-navigation header: a day/month/year switcher plus prev / today / next controls. fully controlled, no router coupling.

name: card
description: compositional bordered card: Card shell plus CardHeader / CardTitle / CardMeta / CardBody / CardActions slots.

name: checkbox
description: square checkbox with a check-on-fill. wraps a native checkbox so it works in forms; thin border, no corners, fills white with a black check when checked.

name: chrome
description: wrapper that renders every text glyph inside it as shimmering chrome foil.

name: code-block
description: syntax-highlighted code box with a built-in copy button. monochrome prism theme tuned for a black background.

name: collapsible-prose
description: splits markdown into collapsible sections on each ## heading. bring your own renderer via renderMarkdown — typically prose.

name: color-swatch
description: a fixed-palette color chip plus a controlled palette picker, with a muted default palette and a next-unused-color helper.

name: combobox
description: searchable select with optional color swatches, inline create, and clear. behavior split into a headless useCombobox hook. generalized from the calendar category picker.

name: copy-button
description: copy-to-clipboard button with copied/error feedback states.

name: count-up
description: animated number that tweens to its target with an easeout curve, starting when scrolled into view. dependency-free requestanimationframe, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

name: desk
description: the full markdown workbench: toolbar, image sidebar, split editor with a two-way synced preview, and floating drawing windows. bring your own markdown renderer; backend ops are callbacks.

name: dialog
description: promise-based confirm and alert dialogs.

name: donut
description: spinning ascii torus baked off-thread in a shared web worker and replayed as a seamless loop. multiple donuts share one bake.

name: drawing-window
description: floating, draggable, resizable paint window: brush/eraser, colors, undo/redo, zoom + pan, and canvas-size presets. save emits png(s) via onSave, or downloads.

name: editor
description: split-pane markdown editor whose live preview scrolls and highlights in sync, both ways. bring your own markdown renderer (e.g. prose).

name: editor-toolbar
description: the bar above a markdown editor: edit/preview/split toggle, format buttons, and an action cluster. with enableDrawing it owns the floating numbered drawing windows.

name: fade-in
description: fade + translate a node in on mount. pure css keyframe with per-instance delay/offset; stagger a list via the staggerDelay helper. honors prefers-reduced-motion.

name: gallery
description: searchable, filterable, sortable project card grid with pinned markers, tech chips, and repo/live links. composes card, badge, and menu.

name: heatmap
description: year activity grid — 12 mini month grids of day cells tinted by value (contribution-graph style), with a less-to-more legend. generalized from the justin06lee.dev year view.

name: image-cropper
description: drag-to-reposition, scroll/slider-to-zoom image cropper. pan and zoom are clamped so the image always covers the frame. emits { url, scale, x, y }.

name: inline-edit
description: blur-to-save editable field. holds a local draft, commits onblur and enter, shows a pending state, rolls back on error, escape cancels. behavior split into a headless useInlineEdit hook.

name: input
description: minimal text input. thin border, no corners.

name: intro
description: full-screen timed multi-step intro overlay with staggered enter/exit, auto-advance, optional skip, and a play-once localStorage gate.

name: login-form
description: styled credential form with loading / error / rate-limited states and enter-to-submit. transport-agnostic via an injected onSubmit; behavior split into a headless useLoginForm hook. rate limiting and lockout belong on the consumer's backend.

name: manager-table
description: admin table with inline rename, swatch recolor, archive, and confirmed delete. every mutation is a callback — bring your own state.

name: menu
description: action dropdown: a trigger opening a list of items, each running its onSelect. optional selected markers (e.g. a sort menu). behavior split into a headless useMenu hook.

name: navbar
description: fixed top nav with inline desktop links and a hamburger-driven slide-in panel below md. routes are caller-supplied; behavior split into a headless useNavbar hook.

name: now-playing-bar
description: sticky bottom bar for a running activity: live elapsed timer and an action slot. omit startedAt for an idle state.

name: pfp
description: profile-picture tile: an image framed in a bordered square, composed on tilt for the 3d hover, with an angled specular glint sweeping diagonally on hover. frame the subject with x/y/scale; size it via className.

name: prose
description: markdown renderer with the justin06lee.dev prose styling — GFM, KaTeX math, heading slugs, and syntax-highlighted code blocks (via code-block). dark-only. pass markdown as the string child.

name: rainbow
description: wrapper that cycles every text character inside it through a staggered rainbow.

name: range
description: thin minimal slider. native input with a custom 12px thumb on a 2px track; thumb scales on hover.

name: scramble
description: wrapper that scrambles every word inside it on hover.

name: segmented
description: controlled segmented control — a row of mutually exclusive options, active one bordered. compact uppercase variant for mode toggles.

name: select
description: styled dropdown select with keyboard navigation and option prefix slots (e.g. palette swatches).

name: sheet
description: animated slide-in panel from a screen edge with a dimmed backdrop. closes on backdrop click, escape, or close button, and locks body scroll while open.

name: showcase
description: framed preview container with a dotted background, optional label, caption, and note. exports a Row helper for explicit row breaks.

name: socials
description: row of social links from a links map — only supplied platforms render. tooltip on hover; the email entry copies to clipboard.

name: sprite-scrubber
description: scrub through a sprite-sheet grid by dragging across it — pointer x maps to a frame index.

name: stack
description: stacked paper card with hovered fan-out spring animation.

name: tabs
description: bordered pill tab-strip. controlled selection with roving-tabindex arrow-key nav and ARIA, split into a headless useTabs hook.

name: tag-input
description: chip input — enter or comma adds a tag, backspace removes the last, suggestions append on click. dedupes and trims.

name: textarea
description: minimal multiline input. matches input — thin border, square corners, vertical resize.

name: theme
description: dark-only chrome CSS variables and @theme inline tokens.

name: tilt
description: 3d perspective tilt card with sweeping shine on hover.

name: timeline
description: day schedule — a 24h vertical axis with positioned event blocks and an optional live now-line. blocks placed by minutes-of-day. generalized from the justin06lee.dev day view.

name: toc
description: sticky table-of-contents with scroll-spy highlighting via IntersectionObserver. give it the page headings; the active row tracks scroll. behavior split into a headless useToc hook.

name: tooltip
description: white slide-up pill shown on hover or keyboard focus. pure CSS, wraps any trigger. aria-hidden — label the trigger itself.

name: utils
description: the cn() helper. clsx + tailwind-merge.
